persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager, starting your Monday
persona.bio: You want the state of the portfolio and the open queues, then to pick one thing to work on. You have not run this before in this folder.

facts.what you expect: a few lines on where studies stand, then the open queues (new builds, personnel requests, data requests, linking requests), then ONE question: which to take
facts.if asked which item to take: say you'll take the first open study build it lists

answers.if_asked: which item, queue or study to take
answers.say: The first open build request you listed.

answers.if_asked: whether to snapshot or where to save
answers.say: Wherever you normally would in my ARGO folder.

persona.stop_when: it has shown the portfolio and the queues and handed you into the build (or asked its one question and you've answered it and it acknowledged)
